covariance.rationale: Newey-West HAC on daily observations with the documented baseline weekly timing (docs/ECONOMETRIC_METHODOLOGY.md 'Estimation and diagnostics': baseline maxlags 7); the lag count is a fixed preregistered number, never selected from the sample or from p-values; sensitivity lags (3 and 14) belong to the NI-053 robustness artifacts, not to this baseline fit.
